article.headline: Cedric Taylor scores 22 as Howard takes down Stetson 75-62
article.description: — Cedric Taylor III’s 22 points helped Howard defeat Stetson 75-62 on Thursday.
article.linkText: Cedric Taylor scores 22 as Howard takes down Stetson 75-62
article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Cedric Taylor III’s 22 points helped Howard defeat Stetson 75-62 on Thursday. Taylor shot 8 of 17 from the field, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 6 from the free-throw line for the Bison (2-2). Drew Harris scored 12 points and added three blocks. Alex Cotton went 4 of 6 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with 10 points. Collin Kuhl finished with 15 points for the Hatters (0-4). Stetson also got 11 points and eight rebounds from Magnus Entenmann. Thiago Sucatzky finished with 11 points and seven assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
